meetings.ours_headline: Parks Commission backed 28 hours for the recreation coordinator and approved a Trails grant application; skate park deal held.

Parks Commission interviewed three project-management firms for the $8.5M park project and ranked Skanska first, NV5 second, Atlantic third.
